current_task_corrections.correction: Change target_definition.threshold_source to 'train_only'. Computing the 95th-percentile threshold only on training data prevents the test distribution from leaking into the target.

Remove billed_amount, allowed_amount, member_oop, and cob_amount from features. These amount fields are directly or indirectly derived from the target (paid_amount) and cause target leakage. Retain: claim_type, cpt_category, place_of_service, provider_specialty, network_status, service_units, length_of_stay, er_flag, elective_flag, preventive_flag, auth_required_flag, primary_icd10_cm, drg_present.
Change preprocessing.fit_on to 'train_only'. Fit the encoder and scaler on training data only to prevent test information from affecting transformation parameters.

reusable_lessons.lesson: When defining a binary target from a percentile in train/test scenarios, compute the threshold on training data only. Using all data leaks test distribution into the target.

Exclude amount fields (billed_amount, allowed_amount, paid_amount, member_oop, cob_amount), pre-computed outcome flags (high_cost_flag), and identifiers (claim_id, member_id) from features in any predictive model. These directly reveal or are derived from the target.
Fit all preprocessing transformers on training data only. Fitting on full data or test data leaks information about test row distributions into the transformation parameters.
